# Third-party base pipeline

`LongLive_StreamEdit` is the LongLive v1.0 implementation of the streaming video editing
pipeline from [StreamEdit](https://github.com/DSL-Lab/StreamEdit). It is vendored here so
that the public interface and configuration can be inspected and integrated without
pulling multiple repositories.

The code is distributed under the Apache License 2.0. See
`LongLive_StreamEdit/LICENSE` and the upstream repository for the original attribution.
The core DualAxisStream identity--motion decoupling modules are not part of this directory.
